skills.detail: A long-range area attack with a Knockback effect. Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP. This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit. Increases damage against [Roger Pirates / Ex-Roger Pirates]. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time. Acquires SPD debuff effect at Level 5.
skills.name: Slicing Wave

skills.detail:
1st Hit:
A mid-range area attack with a chance to inflict Tremor.

2nd & 3rd Hits:
A long-range area attack with a chance to inflict Tremor.

4th Hit:
Moves forward. Creates an area that increases the SPD of you and your allies. The area is removed after a certain period of time or when KO'd.
